# semaphore_ex_project_notification_rule (Resource)

Manages a revisioned Semaphore EX notification routing rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_project_notification_rule" "critical" {
  project_id        = semaphore_ex_project.example.id
  destination_id    = semaphore_ex_project_notification_destination.operations.id
  source_kinds      = ["task", "workflow"]
  lifecycle_actions = ["trigger", "update", "resolve"]
  minimum_severity  = "critical"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_id` (Number)
- `lifecycle_actions` (Set of String)
- `minimum_severity` (String)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `source_kinds` (Set of String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)
